tuesday_updates.text: tuesday updates: System downtime from 10 AM - 12 PM, slowed down workflow. HR sent updated benefits package—review before next month’s deadline. Sent follow-up emails to vendors, waiting on response.

wednesday_updates.text: wednesday updates: Presentation to leadership went well, but need to tweak a few slides for next week’s review. Client proposal draft ready—send it for legal approval. Need to onboard new hire—schedule one-on-one.

thursday_updates.text: thursday updates: Finance wants cost-cutting recommendations—brainstorm ideas. Project deadline approaching—check in with Dev team. Caught a mistake in last month’s sales data.

friday_updates.text: friday updates: Wrapped up pending reports, but still waiting for final approval. Followed up with vendors—two responded, one still pending. Training session next Monday—prep materials this weekend.

urgent_tax_submission.text: urgent tax submission: Submit tax documents before Friday.
probes: urgent tax submission submit tax documents

workout_goals.text: workout goals: Gym at least 3x this week. Focus on strength training—legs and back need work. Try to hit 10,000 steps daily. Stretch before bed—hamstrings too tight.

diet_plan.text: diet plan: Cut back on sugar—too much soda lately. Meal prep on Sunday—grilled chicken, quinoa, and veggies. Hydration—aim for at least 3L of water per day. Protein shake after workouts.

supplements_and_meds.text: supplements and meds: Vitamin D3—1000 IU daily. Omega-3s—good for joints. Iron levels were low last check-up—remember to take supplements. Probiotics—help with digestion, take in the morning.
